summary: Moolec Science SA filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six-month periods ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. The filing is a routine financial update required of foreign private issuers under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is disclosed; the filing solely reports financial results, including revenues from contracts with customers of $5.2M and a net profit of $92.0M for the period, largely driven by a $129.3M gain on deconsolidation of a subsidiary. There are no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or event-driven catalysts to note.
